scope: Root inspections; keyboard changes deferred until cohort closes. Hypotheses are distinguished from recorded facts.

observations.fact: Saved drafts repeatedly appended literal letters directly after selected you without a separator, producing Can youh; later wrong-character selections and full clears were recorded. Completed exact target after 75 activations.
observations.suggestion: Clarify ordinary next-word entry versus literal append behavior near the relevant controls; inspect whether shared word-boundary behavior can match Short Word without compromising the explicit literal lane.
observations.causal_limit: The trace proves effects and choices, not that a label change would improve completion.

observations.fact: Recorded action labels used accessible names such as Append U+0070. The actual extracted tester page included both visible glyph p and its accessible name.
observations.suggestion: Future telemetry should retain visible link text and accessible name separately, so action-only analysis cannot mistake the trace label for the complete presentation. Accessible labels may also include the glyph for screen readers.
observations.causal_limit: Do not attribute observed wrong-character selections to a missing glyph: the tester could see it.

observations.fact: Span entry headings place Literal characters before Find a word, Next words and Short continuations. This tester chose literal composition, successfully explored U+2019, undid it, then stopped with I after 11 activations.
observations.suggestion: Test whether making fast word/continuation choices more prominent improves cold-start discovery.
observations.causal_limit: No coverage failure was established; one early-abandonment trace cannot prove an optimal layout.

observations.fact: After publication, tester followed service.json rather than the public message record.
observations.suggestion: Offer a clearly named direct public-message machine-record link on publication receipts, distinct from service-level Machine entry.
observations.causal_limit: Check all receipt generators before specifying how many traversals a repair saves.
